manifest.title: Help
manifest.author: Adam Smith
manifest.description: Help users understand their group memberships, available models, and manage invite codes.

specs.name: accept_invite
specs.description: Accept a group invitation using an invite key that starts with 'invite-' followed by a JWT. Users sometimes paste the code with _italic_ or *bold* formatting, but you should strip that when submitting the code. If the invite key is not already known from context, calling this tool without invite_key will offer the user a dialog box where they can provide it interactively without serializing it into the conversation history. This interactive input mode is preferred because LLMs sometimes make mistakes when copying detailed texts like keys.

specs.name: create_invite
specs.description:
Yields an 'invite-' style invite code to join the given group by name (the name is often also a URL).
expiry_delta is a phrase like "1y", "6mo", "30d", "12h", "45m", "90s" for how long the invite code stays valid. 30 days is a good default duration.
restrict_email optional makes an invite only usable by one user (otherwise all users, default)

specs.name: get_model_details
specs.description:
Get detailed information about a specific model by its model ID (e.g. "basic", "help").
Returns a curated JSON summary: id, name, description, base_model_id, system prompt,
enabled capabilities, filters, tool IDs, skill IDs, and knowledge collections.
The user must have read access to the model. Remind the user that the system prompt
may appear empty because it is procedurally generated by a filter at request time.

specs.name: list_available_models
specs.description:
List all models the current user can access, with access reason annotations.
Returns JSON: each model entry includes id, name, base_model_id, description, and an "access_reason" field
explaining why the user has access (public, group name, or direct grant).
Useful when a user asks "what models can I use?" or "why can't I find a model?".

specs.name: list_my_groups
specs.description:
List all groups the current user belongs to, with descriptions.
Useful when a user asks "what groups am I in?" or wants to understand their access level.
